chicken_biryani.name: Chicken Biryani
chicken_biryani.health_insights: Good source of lean protein from chicken and aromatic spices (turmeric, cardamom) that have antioxidant properties. Consider pairing with cucumber raita to balance sodium.

paneer_butter_masala.name: Paneer Butter Masala
paneer_butter_masala.health_insights: Rich in dietary calcium and vegetarian protein from paneer. Higher in saturated fats due to butter and cream; pair with whole grain roti instead of refined naan.

masala_dosa.name: Masala Dosa with Chutney
masala_dosa.health_insights: Naturally fermented batter offers gut-friendly probiotics and easy digestibility. Pair with protein-rich lentil sambar for a balanced macronutrient profile.

grilled_salmon_salad.name: Grilled Salmon with Garden Salad
grilled_salmon_salad.health_insights: Exceptional nutritional density! Abundant in Omega-3 fatty acids for cardiovascular and cognitive health, accompanied by fiber-rich leafy greens.

margherita_pizza.name: Margherita Pizza
margherita_pizza.health_insights: Contains lycopene from tomato sauce and calcium from mozzarella, but elevated in refined carbohydrates and sodium. Balance with a fresh green side salad.

avocado_toast_egg.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
avocado_toast_egg.health_insights: Monounsaturated fats from avocado paired with bioavailable complete protein from egg and slow-release dietary fiber from sourdough or multigrain toast.

greek_salad.name: Mediterranean Greek Salad
greek_salad.health_insights: High in polyphenols and monounsaturated oleic acid from extra virgin olive oil, crisp cucumbers, ripe tomatoes, and tangy feta cheese.

chicken_caesar_salad.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
chicken_caesar_salad.health_insights: Great source of lean poultry protein. To optimize health score further, use light yogurt-based dressing or reduce shaved parmesan portion.

cheeseburger.name: Classic Beef Cheeseburger
cheeseburger.health_insights: Rich in protein, zinc, and B12, but calorie-dense and high in saturated fats and sodium. Opt for whole grain bun or lettuce wrap for a healthier alternative.

fresh_apple.name: Crisp Red Apple
fresh_apple.health_insights: High in soluble pectin fiber which lowers cholesterol and nourishes beneficial microbiome bacteria. Abundant in quercetin and Vitamin C.

fresh_banana.name: Fresh Yellow Banana
fresh_banana.health_insights: Rich in potassium (422mg) supporting electrolyte balance and healthy blood pressure. Prebiotic fructooligosaccharides boost gut health.

vegetable_stir_fry.name: Tofu & Vegetable Stir Fry with Brown Rice
vegetable_stir_fry.health_insights: A powerhouse of plant phytonutrients from broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, and organic tofu. High fiber and complex carbohydrates provide sustained energy.

oatmeal_berries.name: Steel-cut Oatmeal with Fresh Berries & Chia
oatmeal_berries.health_insights: Contains beta-glucan soluble fiber clinically proven to reduce LDL cholesterol. Packed with anthocyanin antioxidants from berries and omega-3 ALA from chia.

lentil_soup_dal.name: Yellow Dal Tadka (Lentil Soup)
lentil_soup_dal.health_insights: Excellent source of plant protein, folate, and dietary fiber. Spiced with cumin, garlic, and turmeric for anti-inflammatory benefits.
